verdict.rationale: Calendly's pricing page lists an 'Always free' tier with one-on-one scheduling and a customizable booking page, and signup needs no credit card, so a usable booking link without a paid plan is documented. Community users say the free tier allows only one meeting configuration, and one user reports a feature being moved off the free tier. Those are limits on depth, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: documented free-tier limits (e.g., number of event types, calendar connections), independent hands-on confirmation that the free booking link works for ongoing real use.

support.subject: As a founder, the free tier covers real individual scheduling — a usable booking link without a paid plan

citations.quote: Free: Always free... One-on-one scheduling; Customizable booking page; Browser extension
